title: Bootstrap heft as local Linux build host
description: Per AGENTS.md new 'Local Linux Builder: heft' section: ssh heft (Pop!_OS 24.04, 18 cores, 155G free) currently has cmake/ninja/gcc/python but NO rust, NO Zephyr SDK, NO west, NO LICHEN checkout. Bootstrap: (1) git clone github.com/MarkAtwood/project-LICHEN to ~/project-LICHEN; (2) rustup stable via curl script; (3) only if a bead needs native_sim: mirror the Attic recipe — Zephyr SDK 0.16.8 + west workspace pinned to Zephyr v3.7.0 (do NOT use newer Zephyr; see AGENTS.md version split warning). After bootstrap, verify: cargo build on a small crate, and if Zephyr was installed, west build -b native_sim of lichen/tests/hal. Label needs-linux beads are now claimable on Mac workers via ssh heft.
